item.title: A deep dive into Genstore.ai, a powerful tool for e-commerce entrepreneurs
item.description: Anyone looking to launch an online shop runs into the same questions: Do I need to code? How do I choose the right products? And what about inventory, suppliers, and customer support? Even with traditional online shop platforms and site-building tools, you still need to do most, if not all, of the heavy lifting. That’s where Genstore.ai comes in. more…

item.title: Apple’s search deal with Google could face renewed scrutiny as DOJ appeals antitrust ruling
item.description: Last year, a federal judge ruled that Google had illegally maintained a search monopoly, but allowed the company to keep paying to be the default search engine on Apple devices (with very few caveats). Now, the Department of Justice and a group of states are appealing the overall decision. ￼Here are the details. more…
